audit_items.proof_trace: The early-return guard at L132-135 (`if (last_updated == now) { return }`) ensures the second call with the same timestamp is a no-op. The first call always terminates by calling `self.borrow_index.set_value(new_borrow_index_value, now)` (L148), which stamps `last_updated = now` in `BorrowIndex` (borrow_index.move:28). Therefore any subsequent call with the same `now` immediately returns without touching `debt`, `cash_reserve`, or `borrow_index`.
